name: Sprite
author: E. T. Carter
description: Upper-atmosphere red sprites over a night horizon: violet-to-rose tendrils flash down from the top edge and branch as they fall, each flash leaving a diffuse glowing head that lingers and slowly fades so the sky is never fully dark.

params.label: Episode rate
params.effect: How often streamer clusters fire; min leaves long pregnant gaps, max keeps several clusters alight almost continuously.

params.label: Afterglow
params.effect: How long and strong the diffuse glowing head lingers after each flash; high values keep recently-fired columns softly lit so the sky never snaps to black.

params.label: Reach
params.effect: How far the streamers reach down from the top edge (in CSS pixels) before dissolving.

params.label: Tendrils
params.effect: Number and branching of tendrils per cluster, from two or three lone threads to a dense forking fan.
